# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter supply and higher prices this week; lock in pricing where advised.

## What changed
- Market supply risk eased slightly to **69.2** (‑1.5) while price trend nudged up to **84.2** (+0.1) [1].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged 50.9% YoY, pushing supply tighter [3].  
- Korea chip exports jumped 171% YoY in early Oct, reinforcing demand pressure [5].  
- Fab utilization sits at **76.5%**, just below the 10‑yr average, offering a modest loosening offset [4].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks** with **27,211** units in channel stock [9].  
- Price **$5.56** for qty‑1 and **$2.51** for 1 k [9].  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge) [9].  
- **Buy‑timing call:** *Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)* – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal ordering [9].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – **Rising** (69.6, –0.2), **Rising** price 81.6, **High** confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – **Elevated** (71.2, –0.1), **Rising** price 84.2, **High** confidence.  
- Analog & power management – **Rising** (65.9, –0.2), **Rising** price 83.3, **High** confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – **Rising** (66.7, –1.3), **Rising** price 82.1, **High** confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – **Rising** (62.6, –0.8), **Rising** price 82.4, **High** confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm (factory) [9].

- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 66 % chance of rise, expected **+2.17 %** (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑based edge [10].  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 52 % chance of rise, expected **+4.34 %** (‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline [10].  
- **Fab utilization, next 3 mo:** 63 % chance supply tightens, expected **+1.82 pts** (‑1.71 to +5.36 pts); trend baseline [10].  
- **Fab utilization, next 6 mo:** 60 % chance supply tightens, expected **+3.64 pts** (‑2.16 to +9.45 pts); trend baseline [10].

1. **Lock pricing now** for parts on the “Lock pricing” list (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to avoid the 65 % upside risk while supply remains adequate.
